title: Nutty Molten Vietnamese Chicken Bun Cha
description: Funky, molten Vietnamese dish featuring white wine and caramelized onions, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add coconut oil.
Add sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add chicken breast and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add white wine to the skillet and cook, stirring to scrape up any browned bits, until the liquid is almost completely evaporated, about 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the chicken to a serving plate and top with caramelized onions and chopped peanuts.
Note: If desired, serve with steamed bok choy or noodles on the side.
